# robofolks

> Animated pixel-robot avatars for AI agents and bots, in one dependency-free, MIT-licensed JavaScript package. Any string (an agent's name, a username, a project path) always draws the same robot, and the robot animates to show what that agent is doing: working (`active`), needs you (`needs`), or idle (`waiting`), or walking front, back, left or right.

- 567 robots: 7 paints × 3 builds (walker, tank, ball) × 3 antennas × 3 ear types × 3 chest panels.
- Animated SVGs play with CSS keyframes and need no JavaScript, so they work in `<img>`, READMEs and docs. 1–3 kB gzipped each.
- Also a `<robo-folk>` web component, a React component (React 18 and 19, server rendering), PNG frames, 4×4 sprite sheets and a CLI.
- No dependencies, about 25 kB packed, TypeScript types included. Runs in Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Node, Deno, Bun and workers.
- A string keeps its robot for the life of a major version; seeds and every part combination are pinned by snapshot tests.
- Accessible: each robot is labelled for assistive technology ("Robot avatar, working"), and robots hold still under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Install: `npm install robofolks`

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/kevingoenadibrata/robofolks/blob/main/README.md): install, usage for every entry point, full API, CLI options and the stability promise
- [Demo page](https://kevingoenadibrata.github.io/robofolks/): try any string and see every state
- [Changelog](https://github.com/kevingoenadibrata/robofolks/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## Quick examples

- [Web component](https://github.com/kevingoenadibrata/robofolks#use): `import 'robofolks/element'`, then `<robo-folk seed="kevingo" state="active"></robo-folk>`
- [React](https://github.com/kevingoenadibrata/robofolks#robofolksreact): `import { RoboFolk } from 'robofolks/react'`, then `<RoboFolk seed="kevingo" state="active" size={48} />`
- [Animated SVG string](https://github.com/kevingoenadibrata/robofolks#robofolks): `folkAnimatedSvg('kevingo', 'needs')` from `robofolks`
- [CLI](https://github.com/kevingoenadibrata/robofolks#command-line): `npx robofolks svg kevingo --state active -o kevingo.svg`
